newsitem.title: USA: Rubbermaid posts small profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Rubbermaid posts small profit rise.

text.p: Rubbermaid Inc. Thursday reported a slight increase in profits for the second quarter but the plastic and rubber products maker cautioned that high raw material costs might cut into its results for the rest of the year.
It earned $46.6 million, or 31 cents a share, up from year-earlier earnings of $44.8 million, or 30 cents a share.
The latest results included an after-tax gain of 53 cents per share from the sale of Rubbermaid's Office Products business to Newell Co.
Sales rose 12 percent from the prior year to $640.4 million from $573.0 million, buoyed by its acquisition of Graco Children's Products.
The Wooster, Ohio-based company said high raw material costs and a competitive retailing environment could affect its results during the balance of the year.
Rubbermaid's stock fell $3 to $27.31 in afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
